title: Rebel Shiv Sena (UBT) MP Omprakash Raje Nimbalkar to join Shinde-led Shiv Sena
description: Mr. Nimbalkar arrived in Dharashiv from Pune in the afternoon and interacted with his supporters. He cited the Sena (UBT)'s defeat in the local body elections and his inability to do much for the people because of being in Opposition
